slides.label: NEW
slides.title: Flowtime 2.0 is here!
slides.description:
Flowtime 2.0 is out, with a completely new look and way more customization!
The timer circle is gone. Instead, you can now choose from 15 different timer styles, customize colors, and pick your favorite layout.
Your Quick Starts can also remember their own design settings, so every setup can have its own look!
Head over to settings to set your favorite styles.
Thank you for using Flowtime!
